_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a ZX Spectrum project can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. A project is one tape, snapshot, disc or cartridge.

slots.title: Tape, Snapshot or Disc
slots.help: What goes into the machine. A tape (.tap, .tzx, .pzx, .csw) is loaded as a tape recorder would play it. A snapshot (.z80, .sna, .szx and others) is a whole machine as it stood at one moment, and starts there. A disc is put into the drive of a machine that has one: .dsk for the +3, .trd and .scl for the Pentagon and Scorpion, and the others for the disc interfaces Fuse emulates. A .mdr file is a Microdrive cartridge, a .dck file a Timex cartridge, a .rom file an Interface 2 cartridge. With no file the machine starts in its BASIC. Fuse tells what a file is from its contents.
